incidents.summary: Three Russian drones crossed into Moldova near Căplani around 04:00; two flew toward Olănești before leaving, the third turned back to Ukraine.

sources.title: Informează!

incidents.summary: A Russian Mi-8 helicopter from Kaliningrad crossed into Polish airspace for 42 seconds north of Braniewo. Polish fighters were scrambled.

sources.title: Poland accuses Russian military helicopter of violating its airspace

incidents.summary: At least four Russian drones entered Moldova from Ukraine in the morning; explosions were reported in Florești and Șoldănești districts and northern airspace was closed.

sources.title: Drones in Moldova – The Ministry of Defense reported four unmanned aerial vehicles over the country

incidents.summary: A drone detected over Ukraine near Botoșani entered Romania and crashed near Solca after four minutes. F-16s could not reach it in time.

sources.title: Drone entering Romania from Ukrainian territory crashes

incidents.summary: An aerial object entered Moldova from Odesa Oblast near Novocotovsc and left two minutes later near Pervomaisc.

sources.title: Informează!

incidents.summary: A drone entered Moldova at 05:34 during a massive Russian attack on Ukraine and crashed and exploded near Hîrbovăț.

sources.title: O dronă a intrat în spațiul aerian al Republicii Moldova și s-a prăbușit. Momentul exploziei, surprins de o cameră de supraveghere

incidents.summary: A drone that radar did not detect fell and exploded near Plauru during heavy Russian attacks on Ukraine, leaving a crater and a small fire. No RO-Alert was issued; no injuries.

sources.title: Imagini exclusive cu drona prăbușită în Plauru. Localnicii spun că nu au primit RO-Alert, iar radarele MApN nu au detectat-o

incidents.summary: Six unauthorised overflights were recorded and at least five explosions within 22 minutes. No one was hurt, but a wildfire started near Crocmaz and a farm was heavily damaged.
incidents.attribution_note: Moldova handed Russia's ambassador a protest note; the interior ministry said at least three objects were Banderol missiles.

sources.title: Șase zboruri neautorizate în Moldova, inclusiv rachete și drone. Maia Sandu: „Condamn atacurile masive ale Rusiei asupra Ucrainei”

incidents.location: Palanca border crossing, Ștefan Vodă District
incidents.summary: A projectile from a Russian attack struck the Palanca crossing on the Moldova–Ukraine border, injuring a Moldovan border guard and damaging a bus and a control booth.

sources.title: Projectile injures border guard at Moldova-Ukraine border, hits bus

incidents.summary: Russian drones sank the Turkish-owned freighter Royad Mammadov, carrying Ukrainian maize from Izmail to Ravenna, off Romania; its captain was killed and 11 crew rescued. A Bulgarian tanker carrying grain to Romania was also sunk; its 18 crew were saved.
incidents.attribution_note: Zelensky said Russian drones sank the ships.

sources.title: Russian Drones Sink Royad Mammadov Dry Cargo Ship Carrying Ukrainian Grain
Tote nach Schiffsunglück im Schwarzen Meer - Drohnenangriff?

incidents.summary: About 20 Finnish members of parliament reported break-ins at their homes, in one case with excrement left in the bathroom, which an MP linked to Russian intimidation tactics.
incidents.attribution_note: Senior MP Ben Zyskowicz called it a Russian intimidation plot.

sources.title: Putin's dirty tricks reach Finnish lavatories

incidents.summary: Drones struck two ships in Bulgaria's waters overnight. The HS Dignity, bound for Brăila, sank with only one crew member rescued; the Malta-flagged Chelsea 3, bound for Giurgiulești, was badly damaged and its 15 crew evacuated, five injured.
incidents.attribution_note: Bulgaria's president summoned the Russian ambassador.

sources.title: Schiffe vor Bulgarien mit Drohnen angegriffen - wohl Tote

Новый виток черноморской эскалации. У берегов стран НАТО за девять дней атакованы пять торговых судов. Эксперты считают, что Россия пытается нарушить украинский экспорт и одновременно проверить реакци

incidents.summary: A drone briefly entered Romanian airspace near Sulina before returning to Ukraine, where it was shot down. Two F-16s were scrambled.

sources.title: MApN: Drone enters national airspace near Sulina, two F-16 aicraft scrambled - AGERPRES

incidents.summary: Overnight, three Russian drones entered Moldovan airspace and returned to Ukraine; a fourth crossed twice in the early morning.

sources.title: 4 Russian drones violate Moldovan airspace during overnight attack against Ukraine

incidents.summary: Russian drones struck two chemical tankers near Sulina. The Yara J caught fire at anchor inside Romanian territorial waters with no casualties. The Wine Trader was hit just outside them, and seven crew went missing. On 7 November, Varna prosecutors said badly damaged human remains were found aboard it during repairs.
incidents.attribution_note: Romanian officials said Russian drones hit the ships.

sources.title: Seven sailors missing after drones hit two ships near Romania
Romania resumes search for seven missing sailors from drone-hit ship
Descoperire macabră pe nava lovită de dronă în largul României: rămășițe umane găsite la bord de autoritățile bulgare

incidents.summary: Five Russian drones crashed in Moldova within 24 hours, injuring one person and causing minor damage.
incidents.attribution_note: Moldova's foreign ministry condemned Russia.

sources.title: Moldova condemns Russia after five drones crash on its territory

incidents.summary: Romanian F-16s shot down two jet-powered Geran drones over Romania's territorial waters minutes after they entered its airspace from the area of Snake Island.

sources.title: Informatie de presa – UPDATE
România a doborât două drone care au intrat în spațiul aerian național. Avioanele F-16 au intervenit deasupra Mării Negre

incidents.summary: A drone entered Lithuania from Poland and exploded over the northern village of Juodzionys, where debris was found. Residents in northern and central areas were told to shelter for an hour; cloud kept NATO jets from intercepting it.
incidents.attribution_note: Ukraine regretted the incident and blamed Russian electronic warfare.

sources.title: Lithuanians forced to take shelter after suspected drone enters airspace

incidents.summary: Lithuania said it foiled an attempt to set fire to Starlink satellite equipment in the country.
incidents.attribution_note: Lithuanian authorities said they suspected Russian involvement.

sources.title: Lithuania foils arson attack on Starlink equipment, suspects Russian involvement

incidents.summary: A Russian Geran drone crashed about 100 metres from a house and near an energy facility in Chistelnița during a mass attack on Ukraine.
incidents.attribution_note: Moldova declared a Russian embassy staff member persona non grata.

sources.title: Moldova expels Russian diplomat after Russian Geran drone falls near family homes

incidents.location: Just outside territorial waters off Constanța
incidents.summary: A Russian drone hit the Comoros-flagged bulk carrier Khoryv, which sank off Constanța. One sailor died, three were missing and nine were rescued.
incidents.attribution_note: Romania blamed Russia.

sources.title: Romania blames Russia for drone that sinks cargo ship; 1 killed, 3 missing

incidents.summary: Two drones crossed northern Moldova into north-east Romania during a Russian attack. Four F-16s and a helicopter were scrambled, Iași airport closed and flights were diverted; one drone vanished from radar between Vaslui and Bacău.

sources.title: Comunicat de presa
Alertă de drone în 6 județe. Aeroportul din Iași a fost închis. Două avioane au fost deviate. Armata a ridicat F-16

incidents.summary: A drone crossed Latvian airspace over Krāslava and Ludza for about 17 minutes and left over the Russian border at 19:16. An interceptor drone was launched and later self-destructed. Latvia's armed forces said on 3 November it was most likely a Russian Geran type; whether it was armed is unknown.
incidents.attribution_note: Latvia's National Armed Forces assessed the drone as most likely a Russian Geran; no formal government attribution or blame.

sources.title: Nacionālie bruņotie spēki sniedza papildu informāciju par 1. un 3. novembra incidentiem Latvijas gaisa telpā
More details released about recent drone incidents in Latvia

incidents.summary: The plant lost Ferosplavna-1, its only remaining off-site line, at 02:36 and ran on diesel generators. The IAEA reported this as its 27th total loss of off-site power, with about two weeks of fuel. Power was restored hours later.
incidents.attribution_note: The IAEA said the cause and location are unknown. Energoatom links outages to Russian strikes on lines; the Russian-installed management cited automatic protection.

sources.title: Ukraine's Zaporizhzhya nuclear plant loses all external power for 27th time: UN nuclear watchdog
Power restored to Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant, IAEA says
Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant experiences another blackout
